class s3cima.utils.model.EarlyStopping(patience=10, min_delta=0)[source]

Bases: object

Early stopping to stop the training when the loss does not improve after certain epochs.

Parameters:

  • patience (int) -- Number of epochs to wait before stopping when loss is not improving.

  • min_delta (float) -- Minimum difference between new loss and old loss for new loss to be considered as an improvement.

s3cima.utils.model.fit(dataset: CIMADataset, anchor: str, K: int, ncell: int, genes: list, save_loc: str, nruns: int = 5, dendrogram_cutoff: float = 0.4, n_val_folds: int = 3, maxpool_percentages: list = [1, 5, 10, 20, 50, 100], nfilter_selection: list = [3, 4, 5, 6, 7, 8, 9, 10], dropout: bool = True, dropout_p: float = 0.5, l2: float = 0.0001, background: bool = False, batch_size=256, lr: float = 0.01, epochs: int = 20, num_workers: int = 8, early_stopping=True, patience: int = 3, seed: int = 420, classification: bool = True)[source]

Fit an S3CIMA Model to a dataset.

Parameters:

  • dataset (CIMADataset) -- The dataset to fit the model on.

  • anchor (str) -- Cell type used as the anchor. Neighborhoods are built around cells of this type.

  • K (int) -- Number of nearest neighbors defining the spatial neighborhood around each anchor cell..

  • ncell (int) -- Number of cells in each multi-cell input set passed to the network.

  • genes (list) -- List of gene identifiers.

  • save_loc (str) -- Location to save results.

  • nruns (int, optional) -- Number of runs for the model (default is 5).

  • dendrogram_cutoff (float, optional) -- Cutoff for dendrogram clustering (default is 0.4).

  • n_val_folds (int, optional) -- Number of validation folds (default is 3).

  • maxpool_percentages (list, optional) -- List of maxpool percentages (default is [1, 5, 10, 20, 50, 100]).

  • nfilter_selection (list, optional) -- List of filter selections (default is [3, 4, 5, 6, 7, 8, 9, 10]).

  • dropout (bool, optional) -- Whether to use dropout (default is True).

  • dropout_p (float, optional) -- Dropout probability (default is 0.5).

  • l2 (float, optional) -- L2 regularization parameter (default is 1e-4).

  • background (bool, optional) -- Whether to include background samples (default is False).

  • batch_size (int, optional) -- Batch size for training (default is 256).

  • lr (float, optional) -- Learning rate (default is 0.01).

  • epochs (int, optional) -- Number of training epochs (default is 20).

  • num_workers (int, optional) -- Number of workers for data loading (default is 8).

  • early_stopping (bool, optional) -- Whether to use early stopping (default is True).

  • patience (int, optional) -- Patience for early stopping (default is 3).

  • seed (int, optional) -- Random seed (default is 12345).

  • classification (bool, optional) -- Whether the task is classification (default is True).

Return type:

None

s3cima.utils.model.get_discriminative_filters(save_model: str, nruns: int, validation_subset: Subset, loss_fn, n_classes: int, nmarkers: int, lr: float, batch_size: int, num_workers: int, log_file: str, device: str, accur_thres: float = 0.85, dendrogram_cutoff: float = 0.4, filter_diff_threshold: float = 0.0, result_folder: str = None, genes: list = None, has_background: bool = True, classification: bool = True)[source]
After all runs are complete:

  1. Load each saved run's best model

  2. Evaluate validation accuracy

  3. Collect filter weight vectors from runs passing accur_thres (minimum 3 models always kept regardless of threshold)

  4. Concatenate all passing filter weights into one matrix

  5. Cluster via hierarchical clustering (cosine distance)

  6. Select one consensus filter per cluster (medoid) and calculate filter diff

Filter weights shape per run: (nfilter, nmark) Only filters connected to non-control classes are retained (i.e. output weight to ctrl class [n_classes-1] is NOT the dominant connection).

Parameters:

  • save_model (str) -- Path to the directory containing saved model checkpoints.

  • nruns (int) -- Number of runs to consider.

  • validation_subset (Subset) -- Validation dataset subset.

  • loss_fn (callable) -- Loss function used for evaluation.

  • n_classes (int) -- Number of classes in the classification task.

  • nmarkers (int) -- Number of markers (features) per sample.

  • lr (float) -- Learning rate used during training.

  • batch_size (int) -- Batch size for DataLoader.

  • num_workers (int) -- Number of workers for DataLoader.

  • log_file (str) -- Path to the log file.

  • device (str) -- Device to run the model on (e.g., "cpu" or "cuda").

  • accur_thres (float, optional) -- Accuracy threshold for selecting runs (default is 0.85).

  • dendrogram_cutoff (float, optional) -- Cutoff for hierarchical clustering dendrogram (default is 0.4).

  • filter_diff_threshold (float, optional) -- Threshold for filter difference (default is 0.0).

  • result_folder (str, optional) -- Folder to save results (default is None).

  • genes (list, optional) -- List of gene names corresponding to markers (default is None).

  • has_background (bool, optional) -- Whether the dataset includes background/control samples (default is True).

  • classification (bool, optional) -- Whether the task is classification (default is True).

Returns:

  • consensus_filters (torch.Tensor) -- Tensor containing the consensus filters selected from the clustering.

  • filter_diff (torch.Tensor) -- Tensor containing the differences between the selected filters and the cluster medoids.

s3cima.utils.model.test(model, test_loader, loss_fn, epoch, figure_path, log_file, device)[source]

Test function for the model.

Parameters:

  • model (nn.Module descendant) -- Model through which training data is passed

  • test_loader (DataLoader) -- Test data with features and labels

  • loss_fn (function) -- Method of loss calculation

  • figure_path (str) -- Path to save figures generated during testing.

  • epoch (int) -- Number of passes through the network

Returns:

  • epoch_loss (float) -- Average loss over the test epoch.

  • all_pred_classes (list) -- List of predicted class labels for all test samples.

  • all_true_classes (list) -- List of true class labels for all test samples.

s3cima.utils.model.train(model, train_loader, loss_fn, optimizer, epoch, log_file, device)[source]

Train function for the model. To evaluate the training, multiple different measures are used: Balanced Accuracy, Precision, Recall.

Parameters:

  • model (nn.Module descendant) -- Model through which training data is passed

  • train_loader (DataLoader) -- Training data with features and labels

  • loss_fn (function) -- Method of loss calculation

  • optimizer (function (taken using torch.optim)) -- Optimisation method

  • epoch (int) -- Number of passes through the network

Returns:

  • epoch_loss (float) -- Average loss over the epoch.

  • ba (float) -- Balanced accuracy over the epoch.

  • f1 (float) -- Macro F1-score over the epoch.
